labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new --parallel auto value is a purely additive option that requires no user action.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: captureOnCommitCallbacks now capturing nested callbacks is an additive testing enhancement needing no action from users.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: This is only an introductory pointer stating that the following section concerns third-party database backends, with no change itself.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom database backends overriding year_lookup_bounds methods must accept the new iso_year argument, so third-party backends may break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changing the second argument of _unique_sql() and _create_unique_sql() from columns to fields can break custom schema editor subclasses that rely on the old signature.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removal of PostGIS 2.3 support means deployments on that version must upgrade PostGIS before upgrading Django.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removal of GDAL 2.0 and GEOS 3.5 support means deployments using those libraries must upgrade them.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Dropping PostgreSQL 9.6 and raising the minimum psycopg2 to 2.8.4 requires infrastructure and dependency upgrades.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Dropping Oracle 12.2 and 18c support means deployments on those database versions must upgrade to 19c before upgrading Django.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS values must now include a scheme and wildcard syntax, so existing settings need changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Because CSRF now checks the Origin header, sites using dotted cookie domains may need to configure CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS or requests will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The SECURE_BROWSER_XSS_FILTER setting is removed and the X-XSS-Protection header is no longer set, changing response headers and breaking code referencing the setting.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The autodetector change can cause makemigrations to generate new no-op AlterField migrations for ForeignKey and ManyToManyField, requiring review of generated migrations.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: DeleteView now handles POST via FormMixin, so custom deletion logic in delete() must be moved to form_valid() or the view will behave differently.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The inadvertent Oracle naming change breaks models with long names and requires renaming existing tables and columns via migration work.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing support for cx_Oracle below 7.0 requires upgrading the driver for deployments on Oracle.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The default startproject template now uses STATIC_URL 'static/' without a leading slash, a changed default that can affect existing projects and generated templates.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Calling the admin index view method directly no longer applies never_cache, a behavior change that can affect caching of custom code paths.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Unsupported sliced queryset operations now raise TypeError instead of AssertionError, which breaks code that catches AssertionError.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The reorder_suite() function is renamed and its signature and return type changed, breaking any custom test runners that call it.
